goal.en: Tell a clear work story using the STAR method: situation, task, action, result.
goal.zh: 用 STAR 法則說一個清楚的工作故事：情境、任務、行動、結果。

background: meeting room with a clean whiteboard, a long wooden table with a notepad and a pen, warm pendant lamps, glass wall facing an open office, golden afternoon light

intro.en: Ms. Wong puts down her pen and leans forward.
intro.zh: 王經理放下筆，身體微微前傾。

intro.en: This is the part where she stops asking about you and starts asking for stories.
intro.zh: 接下來，她不再問你是怎樣的人，而是要聽你的故事。

lines.en: Tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem at work.
lines.zh: 說說你在工作上解決過一個困難問題的經驗。

choices.en: Sure. Last year at the design studio, we lost a client's photos.
choices.zh: 好的。去年在設計工作室，我們弄丟了一位客戶的照片。
choices.tip: STAR 的 S（情境）：先用一句話交代時間、地點和發生了什麼。

choices.en: Hmm, I never had any problems. Everything always went smoothly.
choices.zh: 嗯，我從來沒遇過問題，一切都很順利。

lines.en: Never? Lucky you. But I'd still really like to hear an example.
lines.zh: 從來沒有？你真幸運。不過我還是很想聽一個例子。

story.en: Ms. Wong waits. You keep saying everything was fine. She starts to wonder if you have ever worked at all.
story.zh: 王經理等著。你一直說一切都很好。她開始懷疑你到底有沒有真的工作過。

fail.why: 為了面子說「從來沒遇過問題」，在英語面試裡反而像在迴避問題，或沒有實際經驗。大方挑一個問題來說，重點是你怎麼解決。

choices.en: Sure! Once my laptop crashed in the middle of an online game.
choices.zh: 好啊！有一次我打線上遊戲打到一半，筆電當機了。

lines.en: An online game? I meant a problem at work, Kai.
lines.zh: 線上遊戲？凱，我指的是工作上的問題。

story.en: Ms. Wong learns that you lost a very important battle. She still knows nothing about how you work.
story.zh: 王經理知道了你輸掉一場很重要的戰役，卻還是不知道你工作起來是什麼樣子。

fail.why: Tell me about a time... at work 要說工作上的經驗，不是生活瑣事。從工作場合挑一個例子，先交代情境：Last year at the studio, we lost a client's photos.。

choices.en: My coworker broke the hard drive. It was totally his fault, not mine.
choices.zh: 我同事把硬碟弄壞了。完全是他的錯，不是我的。

lines.en: Hmm. I asked what happened, not whose fault it was.
lines.zh: 嗯，我問的是發生什麼事，不是誰的錯。

story.en: Ms. Wong writes 'blames others' in small, neat letters. Your poor coworker isn't even here to defend himself.
story.zh: 王經理用小小的工整字寫下「會怪別人」。你可憐的同事根本不在場，沒辦法替自己辯護。

fail.why: 說故事時急著撇清責任，會讓面試官擔心你不懂團隊合作。只描述事實就好：Our hard drive died, and the client's launch was in two days.。

choices.en: Our hard drive died, and the client's launch was in two days.
choices.zh: 我們的硬碟壞了，而客戶兩天後就要上市。
choices.tip: STAR 的 T（任務）：說出問題有多急、你必須達成什麼。

choices.en: Our hard drive was die, and the launch was after two days.
choices.zh: 我們的硬碟掛了，而上市是在兩天之後。

lines.en: Was die? And after two days... so the launch was already over?
lines.zh: Was die？兩天之後……所以上市已經結束了？

story.en: Ms. Wong thinks the deadline had already passed. Your exciting race against time suddenly has no race.
story.zh: 王經理以為期限早就過了。你緊張刺激的搶時間故事，突然沒了懸念。

fail.why: die 是動詞，過去式是 died，不能說 was die。「兩天後要上市」說 in two days；after two days 是指「過了兩天之後」。

lines.en: That sounds stressful. So what did you do?
lines.zh: 聽起來壓力很大。那你做了什麼？

choices.en: I just waited for my boss to decide. I didn't want to cause trouble.
choices.zh: 我就等老闆決定，我不想惹麻煩。

lines.en: So... you didn't really do anything?
lines.zh: 所以……你其實什麼都沒做？

story.en: Your story has a hero, and it's your old boss. Ms. Wong wonders if she should interview your boss instead.
story.zh: 你的故事有個英雄，但那是你的前老闆。王經理考慮是不是乾脆去面試你老闆。

fail.why: 在台灣，等主管決定是種謹慎；但 STAR 的 A（行動）要說「你」做了什麼。用 I + 動作動詞：I made a plan with my boss, and we reshot the photos.。

choices.en: I made a plan with my boss, and we reshot 20 key photos overnight.
choices.zh: 我和老闆擬了計畫，我們連夜重拍了 20 張主要照片。
choices.tip: STAR 的 A（行動）：用 I + 過去式動詞，說出你採取的具體行動。

choices.en: I shouted 'add oil!' to myself and worked the whole night with my team.
choices.zh: 我對自己大喊「加油！」，然後和團隊熬了一整夜。

lines.en: Add oil? To the hard drive? Did that help?
lines.zh: 加油？加到硬碟裡？那有用嗎？

story.en: Ms. Wong now pictures you pouring cooking oil into a computer. You spend your best minute explaining a cheer.
story.zh: 王經理腦中浮現你把沙拉油倒進電腦的畫面。你最精彩的一分鐘，全拿來解釋一句加油口號。

fail.why: 「加油」直譯成 add oil，很多外國人聽不懂。而且熬夜加油不是具體行動，要說清楚你做了什麼：We reshot 20 key photos overnight.。

lines.en: Impressive. And what was the result?

choices.en: The client got every photo on time and signed a new contract with us.
choices.zh: 客戶準時拿到所有照片，還和我們簽了新合約。
choices.tip: STAR 的 R（結果）：用具體成果收尾，最好有數字或後續好消息。

choices.en: The client was very satisfy and sign a new contract with us.
choices.zh: 客戶非常滿意，還和我們簽了新合約。

lines.en: Satisfy... sign? Sorry, so were they happy in the end?
lines.zh: Satisfy……sign？抱歉，所以他們最後滿意嗎？

story.en: Your best moment comes out in pieces. Ms. Wong has to put the happy ending together herself.
story.zh: 你最精彩的部分說得支離破碎。王經理只好自己拼湊出這個好結局。

fail.why: 描述人的感受要用 satisfied（感到滿意），過去發生的事要用過去式 signed：The client was very satisfied and signed a new contract.。

choices.en: The result? I slept for fourteen hours the next day, haha.
choices.zh: 結果？我隔天睡了十四個小時，哈哈。

lines.en: Well earned! But what happened with the client?
lines.zh: 辛苦了！不過客戶那邊後來怎麼樣？

story.en: Ms. Wong laughs, but your story ends with you in bed instead of with a happy client.
story.zh: 王經理笑了，但你的故事結尾是你在睡覺，而不是滿意的客戶。

fail.why: STAR 的 R 是工作上的成果，不是你自己累到睡多久。說出客戶或公司得到什麼：The client got every photo on time.。

lines.en: Great story. What did you learn from it?
lines.zh: 很棒的故事。你從中學到什麼？

choices.en: I learned that I should never trust my coworkers with anything again.
choices.zh: 我學到再也不要把任何事交給同事。

lines.en: That's a tough lesson for a job where everyone works as a team, Kai.
lines.zh: 凱，這份工作大家都是團隊合作，這種心得有點難辦。

story.en: Your great story ends on a sour note. Ms. Wong imagines you refusing to share a stapler.
story.zh: 精彩的故事卻有個苦澀的結尾。王經理想像你連釘書機都不肯跟人共用。

fail.why: 最後的心得要正面、能用在新工作上。說 Always back up your files, and stay calm when plans fall apart.，不要抱怨同事。

choices.en: I have learned it that I must to back up files every day.
choices.zh: 我學到我每天都必須備份檔案。

lines.en: Learned it that... must to...? I think I got it. Backups, right?
lines.zh: Learned it that……must to……？我想我懂了，是備份對吧？

story.en: Ms. Wong nods slowly. The big finish of your story gets stuck in the grammar.
story.zh: 王經理慢慢地點頭。你故事最有力的結尾，卡在文法裡出不來。

fail.why: learned 後面直接接 that 子句，不加 it；must 後面接原形動詞，不加 to：I learned that I must back up my files every day.。

choices.en: Always back up your files, and stay calm when plans fall apart.
choices.zh: 一定要備份檔案，計畫出錯時也要保持冷靜。
choices.tip: 故事最後補一句心得，讓面試官知道你會把經驗帶到新工作。

lines.en: Situation, task, action, result. You told that like a pro.
lines.zh: 情境、任務、行動、結果。你說得跟專業人士一樣。

lines.en: Ms. Wong closes her notepad. Only one part of the interview is left.
lines.zh: 王經理闔上筆記本。面試只剩最後一個部分了。

story.en: A lost hard drive became your best interview answer. Sometimes the worst days make the best stories.
story.zh: 一顆壞掉的硬碟，成了你最好的面試答案。有時候最糟的一天，會變成最好的故事。

notes.explain: 回答 Tell me about a time... 的標準架構。依序說：發生什麼事、你要達成什麼、你做了什麼、結果如何。全部用過去式。

example.en: We were short of staff, so I trained two new people in a week.
example.zh: 我們人手不足，所以我一週內訓練了兩位新人。

notes.en: Tell me about a time when...
notes.explain: 行為面試題的固定開頭。聽到它就知道要講一個真實故事，不是講你的個性。

example.en: Tell me about a time when you worked under pressure.
example.zh: 說說你在壓力下工作的一次經驗。

notes.en: in two days / after two days
notes.zh: 兩天後（從現在算）／過了兩天之後
notes.explain: 說「再過兩天就要……」用 in two days；after two days 是指某件事發生之後又過了兩天。

example.en: The launch is in two days, so we have to hurry.
example.zh: 兩天後就要上市了，我們得趕快。

notes.explain: 「加油」直譯成 add oil，很多外國人聽不懂。替別人打氣說 You can do it! 或 Good luck!；說自己努力，就直接說出具體行動。

example.en: You can do it! Good luck with the launch.

notes.zh: 說「我」做了什麼，不要怪別人
notes.explain: 英語面試想聽你個人的行動，所以多用 I made、I called。同時不要把問題推給同事或老闆，那會讓人擔心你的團隊合作。

example.en: I called the client myself and explained the new plan.
example.zh: 我親自打給客戶，說明新的計畫。
